# ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry Daily Update (Jul 31, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
The day saw significant activity in issue closure, primarily focusing on deprecating `op-program` related tasks and resolving legacy "Standard L2 Genesis" items. A new pull request was opened to update Sepolia standard versions.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

No new features, bug fixes, refactoring, documentation enhancements, or tests were added today.

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- A new pull request, [#1298](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/pull/1298), was opened to add Sepolia standard versions for `op-contracts/v8.0.0-rc.2`.

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Deprecation of `op-program` Related Issues
A large number of issues related to `op-program` were closed as "not planned" due to its removal from the monorepo in favor of the Rust `kona-client`. This includes issues concerning building with custom configs [#15944](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/15944), prestate creation for interop upgrades [#15965](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/15965), Go SSA callgraph analysis [#11229](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/11229), hash scheme dependency removal [#11551](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/11551), TinyGo compilation [#11548](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/11548), non-determinism sanitization [#11667](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/11667), host request timeouts [#12678](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/12678), recursive block execution prevention [#13663](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/13663), consolidation step bypass [#15205](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/15205), transitionState sanity checks [#15199](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/15199), bedrock contracts test setup failures [#15220](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/15220), reproducible prestate issues [#15273](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/15273), reproducibility verification revision [#17156](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/17156), and engine API checks [#17336](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/17336).

### Resolution of Legacy "Standard L2 Genesis" Tasks
Several issues related to the "Standard L2 Genesis" effort were closed as "not planned" or "completed" as the effort has been superseded by newer architectures or completed through other means. This includes tasks like failure mode analysis [#12296](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/12296), `FeeVault` modifications [#12297](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/12297), `OptimismPortal` modifications [#12298](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/12298), `CrossDomainMessenger` changes [#12300](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/12300), Isthmus tracking [#12302](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/12302), `SuperchainConfig` upgrader role [#12305](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/12305), L1 contracts using OZ v5 Initializable [#12655](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/12655), preventing exceeding L2BlockGasLimit [#12578](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/12578), preventing start block misconfiguration [#12579](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/12579), Semgrep rule for non-initializable predeploys [#12580](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/12580), L2 Genesis file generation [#12708](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/12708), renaming the `uprgrader` role [#12861](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/12861), adding `setFeeVaultConfig` calls to `SystemConfig.init` [#13038](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/13038), and addressing audit findings [#13043](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/13043).

### Contract and Deployment Process Improvements
Several issues related to contract management and deployment were closed. This includes the removal of immutable `L2_CHAIN_ID` from `FaultDisputeGame.sol` [#11323](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/11323), the separation of `op-deployer` from `op-chain-ops` [#11925](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/11925), and modifications to `L2 ProxyAdmin` [#12303](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/12303), `OptimismMintableERC721Factory` [#12304](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/12304), `SystemConfig` [#12299](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/12299), and `StandardBridge` [#12301](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/12301].

### Miscellaneous Issue Closures
Other closed issues include a one-off L2 Contracts Release action item [#11778](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/11778), a Contract Versioning Tool that was superseded by existing CI and release workflows [#11907](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/11907), a gas usage test for OPCM that is now obsolete [#13021](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/13021), a checklist for shipping contracts to prod that has been superseded [#13228](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/13228), a support request for a stuck withdrawal transaction [#13466](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/13466), the addition of a default `M-needs-triage` label to issues [#13647](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/13647), an `op-deployer` build/usage issue with missing details [#13939](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/13939), a legacy deployment issue with `deploy-config.json` [#13966](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/13966), revised OPCM bounty and audit processes that have been superseded [#14055](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/14055), OPCM permissionless game deployment [#14235](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/14235], a `mise` install error [#17963](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/17963), and a `Kona` safe head DB issue superseded by another issue [#18748](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/18748).

## NEW ISSUES

- A new issue, [#22166](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/22166), was opened regarding a 150k gas divergence in Lagoon upgrade gas handling between `op-node` and `kona`.

## ACTIVE ISSUES

- **Lagoon upgrade gas divergence** [#22166](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/22166): The issue describes a 150k gas divergence in how `op-node` and `kona` strip upgrade gas during the Lagoon upgrade. The latest comment from `sebastianst` clarifies that existing acceptance tests, both single-chain and multi-chain, do not cover the post-activation block where this divergence occurs. Extending the acceptance test span by one block is suggested to cover the multi-chain scenario.

- **opgeth-decoupling: check-* fork tools** [#21746](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/21746): The latest comment from `claude` confirms that `check-derivation` was deleted in #22164, resolving that part of the issue.
